repository.description: Backend platform for web, mobile and Flutter developers
repository.readme:
# Appwrite

Appwrite is an open source backend platform that bundles authentication, databases, storage, functions and realtime in one API.

## Web SDK

Install with `npm install appwrite` and create a client:

    const client = new Client().setEndpoint('https://cloud.appwrite.io/v1').setProject('<PROJECT_ID>');
    const account = new Account(client);

Sign in a user with `account.createEmailPasswordSession(email, password)`.

## Webhooks

Appwrite sends an HTTP POST to your URL when an event happens, for example `users.*.create` when a user signs up or `databases.*.collections.*.documents.*.create` when a document is created. The body is the created resource as JSON. Verify that the request comes from Appwrite by checking the `X-Appwrite-Webhook-Signature` header with your webhook signature key.

## Storage

Store and serve files with permissions per bucket.

ideas.summary: Usar el SDK web de Appwrite para que los huéspedes creen su cuenta e inicien sesión en una app de turismo, sin programar ni mantener un backend de autenticación propio.
